title: Biased bounded-error time class
statement: For a real bias parameter $\rho$ and a time bound $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the class consists of languages $L$ for which there are a natural number $c$ and a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet such that $N$ decides $L$ within time $n\mapsto cT(n)$ with bias $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
